The actions described in the paragraph likely violate legal standards regarding labor laws. Extending working hours beyond the maximum permitted by local labor laws is illegal, regardless of whether management claims it is a one-time exception or due to high demand. Labor laws typically set strict limits on working hours to protect employee health and safety, and these limits cannot be waived by employer discretion. Additionally, failing to increase pay for extended hours may violate minimum wage and overtime regulations, which generally require additional compensation for hours worked beyond the standard workweek.

Regarding the taste of sugar: Sugar has a distinct sweet taste, which is one of the five basic tastes recognized by humans. It is characterized by a quick, intense sweetness that is often described as pleasant and satisfying. The sweetness of sugar is primarily due to its ability to bind to sweet taste receptors on the tongue, triggering signals to the brain that interpret the sensation as sweet.
